candidates.public_label: Solid-rocket engineering no-launch recommendation and management reversal
candidates.artifact_summary: The presidential commission record preserves the written no-launch threshold, engineering data basis, recipient challenge, management caucus and reversal, continuing engineer opposition, and loss of dissent before the final launch gate.
missing_receipts: original teleconference transmission headers and recipient acknowledgments
complete authorship allocation across the recommendation charts
support and authority ledger for each contributing engineer
independent handoff or cross-domain transfer evidence
candidates.falsifier: Contemporaneous records showing that the written no-launch recommendation was not engineering-authored, was withdrawn by the engineers on new evidence, or never reached the contractor decision surface would defeat advancement.

candidates.public_label: Marine accident without a documented pre-action qualified contradiction
candidates.artifact_summary: The official accident record establishes flooding, open watertight doors, vessel loss, and ordinary operational causes, but contains no original outsider claim, qualified pre-action warning, or retaliation merits file.
missing_receipts: original allegation, prediction, or work object
qualified pre-action contradiction delivered to a decision surface
merits record comparing the claim against the ordinary explanation
candidates.falsifier: A source-addressable pre-action warning by a qualified operator tied to the open-door or flooding risk would defeat retention as an accident-without-K0-preconditions control.

candidates.public_label: Pressure-vessel design and inspection warning before catastrophic rupture
candidates.artifact_summary: The CSB record preserves a third-party safety auditor’s design, fabrication, material, cracking, return-to-service, and public-fatality warnings, the company’s continued operation without inspection, and the later rupture matching the warned scenario.
missing_receipts: complete original auditor report bytes and routing metadata
individual authorship and recipient acknowledgment
resource and authority ledger for the auditor
independent handoff or unrelated-domain transfer artifact
candidates.falsifier: The original report showing no recommendation against return to service, no cracking assessment, or no public-fatality warning would defeat advancement.

candidates.public_label: Rail oversight inspector general retire-or-face-allegations ultimatum
candidates.artifact_summary: A congressional minority staff report preserves the ultimatum, claimed interference with an investigation, statutory notice failure, and checking-function context, while an official OIG audit establishes contemporaneous work output. The complete board file and independent merits review remain absent.
missing_receipts: complete minority staff report and all exhibits in exact custody
complete board deliberation, cause allegations, and legal advice
independent or bipartisan merits determination
support-normalized attribution connecting a specific work product to the ultimatum
candidates.falsifier: A complete board record establishing an independently documented nonretaliatory removal basis fixed before the investigation would reverse the current hypothesis.

candidates.public_label: Binding authorship conflict adjudication and anti-retaliation route
candidates.artifact_summary: The NIH policy supplies a detailed binding adjudication architecture, factfinding, conflict screening, appeals, records, anti-retaliation rules, and journal enforcement, but no source-addressable observed case or durable relationship outcome.
missing_receipts: one observed conflict entering the policy
pre-conflict and post-decision authorship state
binding decision and implementation receipt
durable relationship or handoff state after correction
candidates.falsifier: Evidence that the policy cannot produce a binding decision or cannot be enforced against covered researchers would defeat retention even as architecture.

candidates.public_label: Clinical-research warnings mishandled before external inquiry and correction
candidates.artifact_summary: Institutional and external records preserve clinical and research warnings, flawed internal handling, an external management inquiry, a renewed misconduct finding, institutional apology to whistleblowers, and later publication retractions.
missing_receipts: one complete original whistleblower report tied to one decision transaction
complete employment and access consequences for each reporter
durable post-correction relationship and custody state
basis for reducing the distributed failure to one partnership or operator
candidates.falsifier: A complete record showing the warnings lacked access to relevant patient or research evidence, or that the institution adopted the same correction before external intervention, would narrow or defeat advancement.
